name: literature-zotero-mcp
description: A Zotero MCP for evidence workflows with auditable, read-only duplicate candidate detection.
long_description: Literature Zotero MCP provides Zotero Web API and desktop local API access for evidence workflows, including search, safe writes, citations, and read-only batch duplicate detection with persistent audit reports. Final duplicate merges remain in Zotero Desktop.

api_key.title: Zotero API Key
api_key.description: Create one at https://www.zotero.org/settings/keys. Optional if you only read your local Zotero 7+ library, but required for writes, sync, and group libraries.

local.title: Zotero local API
local.description: Use the Zotero 7+ desktop local API for fast, key-free reads: auto | on | off.
